purpose: Propose a coherent hierarchy for the complete supplied Day 1 scope in one logical Stage H job.
authority_order: Treat scope_id, ordered unit records, deterministic choice ownership, and hard locks as exact Python-owned constraints.
Group only supplied authority-bound unit IDs, preserve their complete order and ownership, and reference each unit exactly once.
Use temporary proposal_key values only to connect proposed beat groups to proposed major clusters. They are non-authoritative transport keys and will never become topology IDs.
Flag uncertain supplied unit IDs without removing, duplicating, or relocating them.
hard_rules: Return a whole-scope proposal, not independent adjacent-gap classifications.
Do not cross deterministic choice, choice-arm, call-occurrence, loop, sequence, lane, hard-lock, or scope boundaries.
Do not output titles, summaries, characters, claims, graph nodes, graph edges, choice topology, requirements, effects, coordinates, locators, or authoritative IDs.
Do not invent unit IDs or evidence IDs.
forbidden: use filesystem, web, tools, MCP, private oracle, mockup, Gemini, Grok, or application authority
infer hidden material or repair missing authority by guessing
turn proposal keys into stable or authoritative identity
